description: Return the model's rated selections for a league: estimated win probability, fair decimal odds and a worded confidence (HIGH / LEAN / LONG-SHOT). Contains no bookmaker prices — this is model output only, so it cannot tell you where to bet or at what price.

feed.description: "picks" = everything ranked, "games" = game lines only, "props" = player props only.

minProbabilityPct.description: Only return selections the model rates at or above this probability.

name: get_model_picks
title: Get model picks for a league
